description.value:
As an heir of House Lyrandar, the wind is your ally, and the sea and sky are your domain. Despite the ravages of the Last War, your house is rising, lifted by its mastery of the new airships. You may have begun your career at sea as a sailor or navigator, as a shipwright, or in the Raincallers' Guild, shaping the weather for irrigation and similar public works. Or you were among the first of your house to take to the skies with an airship crew. Serving the house might lead you to hunt pirates on the Lhazaar Sea, search ancient ruins for the magic that binds elemental forces, or salvage a wrecked airship in the Mournland.

Ability Scores: Strength, Dexterity, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.IpBWHhssqHDCkiSC]{Mark of Storm}

Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics and Nature

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulNavigators]{Navigator's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulNavigators]{Navigator's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP
